units.text: INT. FUNICULAR CAR - NIGHT
A little wooden car climbs a steep rail through pine forest toward a sleeping hotel.
Brass lamps, velvet benches, a locked steel case strapped to the floor.
MIRABEL STROUD, 40s, sleek in a conductor's uniform that does not quite fit, stands at the brake lever.
JUNIOR OKAFOR, 20s, in porter's livery, perches on the case with a thermos.
LUCAS PIERRE, 50s, a quiet man in a traveling coat, sits at the far end with a newspaper.
Smooth ride, Mirabel. Real smooth.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: Don't jinx it.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Nothing to jinx. Two minutes to the top, one case, three honest people.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: Four if you count the case.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: Junior, the cable.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: What about it?
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: Mirabel's eyes go to the cable humming in its groove.

Junior unscrews the thermos, takes a sip, offers it to Lucas, who shakes his head, folds the newspaper in half, and tucks it under his arm, while Mirabel slides one hand off the brake lever and into her jacket, and the car creaks past a lantern marking the halfway pole.
Tell me, Mirabel. Who's at the top?
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: Night clerk. Maybe a guest or two.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: The clerk's asleep.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: How would you know?
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: I did the schedule.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: You did the schedule?
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: I did a schedule. Not the schedule.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: Interesting.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: Junior stands.
The thermos slips from his hand and rolls to Lucas's shoe.
Lucas stops it with a toe, picks it up, unscrews the cap, and tips the contents onto the floor.
It is not coffee.
It is a thin pool of clear oil that spreads toward the case.
That's brake fluid.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: It's not what it looks like.
units.name: JUNIOR

units.text: It's exactly what it looks like. Mirabel, stop the car.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: If I stop here, we slide.
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Then slide gently.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: Mirabel draws a pistol from her jacket and levels it at Junior.
Lucas stands, opens his traveling coat, and shows a badge.
Funicular Authority, Inspector Pierre. Which of you wants to explain the oil?
units.name: LUCAS
